answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, for each epoch, evaluate a committed polynomial whose secret encodes their private key. Semaphore membership proofs authenticate messages, while RLN rate limits permit only one share per epoch: duplicate messages expose correlated polynomial evaluations, enabling Shamir interpolation to recover the key and trigger instantaneous collateral slashing. Consequently, sybil identities cannot wander freely; timber and onyx agents face the same stake-backed cost.
